resourceProfile.assessment: The complete English and Nynorsk source scope, review metadata, glossary, and project concept references were available locally.

automatedQuality.summary: Translation review metadata, queue validation, typecheck, 79 test files with 462 tests, complete build, 39 IIS rules with 61 route cases, and 724 generated-link checks passed.

linguisticCritique.summary: An independent whole-locale pass identified 25 actionable Nynorsk translation defects in the remaining TCR and trigonometry text; all 25 were corrected in this bounded iteration.

competentHumanReview.summary: No competent Nynorsk human review was performed in this cycle; changed IDs remain machine-drafted.

publicationAuthorization.summary: No merge, publication, deployment, or residual-risk authorization was requested or granted.

findings.summary: The temperature-scale bullet retained the Bokmål form temperaturene and verb bruke.
evidence: Before: Temperaturene må bruke samme skala ...
findings.resolution: Changed to Nynorsk temperaturane and må bruke same skala.

findings.summary: The positive-TCR bullet used Bokmål article, verb, and plural forms.
evidence: Before: En positiv TCR betyr at motstanden øker når temperaturen stiger; mange metaller oppfører seg slik.
findings.resolution: Changed to Nynorsk Ein, tyder, aukar, stig, and metall forms.

findings.summary: The negative-TCR bullet used Bokmål article, verb, and temperature form.
evidence: Before: En negativ TCR betyr at motstanden synker når temperaturen stiger.
findings.resolution: Changed to Nynorsk Ein, tyder, søkk, and stig forms.

findings.summary: The near-zero TCR bullet retained Bokmål verb and preposition forms.
evidence: Before: En TCR nær null betyr at motstanden endrer seg lite innenfor det angitte området.
findings.resolution: Changed to Nynorsk Ein, tyder, endrar, innanfor, and oppgitte forms.

findings.summary: The coefficient-sign bullet retained several Bokmål forms.
evidence: Before: Fortegnet ... viss en negativ verdi erstattes ... snus forutsigelsen.
findings.resolution: Rewrote the sentence with Nynorsk forteikn, ein, blir erstatta, and føreseiing forms.

findings.summary: The worked-example title used the Bokmål form Regneeksempel.
evidence: Before: Regneeksempel.
findings.resolution: Changed to: Rekneeksempel.

findings.summary: The heated-resistor example title used Bokmål article and participle forms.
evidence: Before: En oppvarmet motstand.
findings.resolution: Changed to: Ein oppvarma motstand.

findings.summary: The worked-example setup used Bokmål article and indefinite-form wording.
evidence: Before: En motstand ... med en TCR ...
findings.resolution: Changed to Nynorsk Ein motstand and ein TCR.

findings.summary: The worked-example conclusion used the Bokmål adverb omtrent.
evidence: Before: omtrent 3,2 % høgare.
findings.resolution: Changed omtrent to the Nynorsk om lag.

findings.summary: The practical-limits title used the Bokmål form begrensninger.
evidence: Before: TCR, effekt og praktiske begrensninger.
findings.resolution: Changed to: TCR, effekt og praktiske avgrensingar.

findings.summary: The constant-voltage explanation retained Bokmål forms throughout.
evidence: Before: For en motstand ... drives ... øker ... strømmen ... en konstantstrømkilde.
findings.resolution: Rewrote the paragraph with Nynorsk articles, verbs, and constant-current terminology.

findings.summary: The TCR applicability paragraph retained Bokmål forms for specification and self-heating.
evidence: Before: Produsentens TCR gjelder normalt for et angitt ... selvoppvarming ... avviker.
findings.resolution: Rewrote the paragraph with Nynorsk produsenten sin, gjeld, oppgitt, sjølvoppvarming, and avvik forms.

findings.summary: The trigonometry description retained the Bokmål verb knytter and noun modeller.
evidence: Before: Trigonometri knytter sammen vinkler ... geometriske modeller.
findings.resolution: Changed to Nynorsk knyter, vinklar, and modellar.

findings.summary: The right-triangle title used Bokmål adjective and noun forms.
evidence: Before: Rettvinklede trekanter.
findings.resolution: Changed to: Rettvinkla trekantar.

findings.summary: The right-triangle explanation was largely Bokmål.
evidence: Before: Relativt til en vinkel ... motstående ... hosliggende ... en huskeregel.
findings.resolution: Rewrote the paragraph with Nynorsk angle, side, adjacent, and mnemonic terminology.

findings.summary: The sine formula used the Bokmål form motstående.
evidence: Before: sin(θ) = motstående / hypotenuse.
findings.resolution: Changed to: sin(θ) = motståande / hypotenuse.

findings.summary: The cosine formula used the Bokmål form hosliggende.
evidence: Before: cos(θ) = hosliggende / hypotenuse.
findings.resolution: Changed to: cos(θ) = hosliggjande / hypotenuse.

findings.summary: The tangent formula used Bokmål side terminology.
evidence: Before: tan(θ) = motstående / hosliggende.
findings.resolution: Changed to Nynorsk motståande and hosliggjande.

findings.summary: The unknown-sides title used Bokmål forms.
evidence: Before: Finn ukjente sider og vinkler.
findings.resolution: Changed to: Finn ukjende sider og vinklar.

findings.summary: The example title used the Bokmål article en.
evidence: Before: Finn en side.
findings.resolution: Changed to: Finn ei side.

findings.summary: The example setup used Bokmål article and verb forms.
evidence: Before: En hypotenus ... danner en vinkel.
findings.resolution: Changed to Nynorsk Ein hypotenus ... dannar ein vinkel.

findings.summary: The example conclusion used the Bokmål article and participle kjente.
evidence: Before: Bruk en invers ... når sidelengdene er kjente.
findings.resolution: Changed to Nynorsk ein and kjende.

findings.summary: The inverse-sine formula used the Bokmål form motstående.
evidence: Before: θ = sin^-1(motstående / hypotenuse).
findings.resolution: Changed to: θ = sin^-1(motståande / hypotenuse).

findings.summary: The inverse-cosine formula used the Bokmål form hosliggende.
evidence: Before: θ = cos^-1(hosliggende / hypotenuse).
findings.resolution: Changed to: θ = cos^-1(hosliggjande / hypotenuse).

findings.summary: The inverse-tangent formula used Bokmål side terminology.
evidence: Before: θ = tan^-1(motstående / hosliggende).
findings.resolution: Changed to Nynorsk motståande and hosliggjande.
